supersedes: V1 (implicit from bridge output, never formally versioned)

clean_action_7d.description: Counterfactual clean policy action. Same-state forward pass BEFORE any attack perturbation. Raw model output in normalized LIBERO action space [-1, 1].

clean_env_action_7d.description: Counterfactual clean execution action. clean_action_7d passed through standard postprocessing (unnormalize, clip, discretize, gripper convert). Same pipeline as attack env_action_7d, without attack-specific modifications.

raw_action_7d.description: Attack policy action. Model output after perturbation applied, before any postprocessing.

env_action_7d.description: Final attack execution action sent to MuJoCo environment. After unnormalization, clipping, discretization, gripper conversion, and optional arm_lock.

postprocessing_pipeline: gripper: convert continuous to binary via postprocess_openvla_action_for_libero

arm_lock.description: Optional. When enabled, attack_action[0:6] = clean_action_np[0:6].copy(). env_action_7d reflects post-lock state.

nad_computation.policy_nad: compare(raw_action_7d, clean_action_7d) — both in normalized policy space
nad_computation.execution_nad: compare(env_action_7d, clean_env_action_7d) — both in execution space
nad_computation.note: ARM NAD is macro-average over 6 arm dimensions. Gripper NAD is reported separately. Never average all 7 dimensions together.
